title: Statistics v4 response shapes (Nocturne-compatible)
description: Maintainer, 2026-10-26: Nightscout's v4 statistics reads match Nocturne's StatisticsController for hub compatibility. These are the response shapes of its ten GET reads over stored data, read from the C# models of Nocturne `main` 89dcaf1dd (src/Core/Nocturne.Core.Models/StatisticsModels.cs, PunchCardModels.cs and the types they use) by a parser of public property declarations, with ASP.NET Core's default JSON naming (camelCase) and enums serialised as integers unless the type carries JsonStringEnumConverter. Read-derived: nothing was run, and nested types were not checked by hand. Each $defs entry names its source file and line. Members not listed are ignored (G1).

DiabetesPopulation.description: Nocturne 89dcaf1dd src/Core/Nocturne.Core.Models/StatisticsModels.cs:1096; serialised as an integer (no string converter on the type); names in order: Type1Adult, Type2Adult, Type1Pediatric, Elderly, Pregnancy, PregnancyType1

GRIZone.description: Nocturne 89dcaf1dd src/Core/Nocturne.Core.Models/StatisticsModels.cs:1278; serialised as an integer (no string converter on the type); names in order: A, B, C, D, E
